definitionEn: v. bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted\nv. provide a service or favor for someone

example.text: The law obliges all drivers to carry valid insurance.
example.translationZh: 法律要求所有司机都必须持有有效的保险。

definitionEn:
v force somebody to do something
v bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted
v provide a service or favor for someone
s showing a cheerful willingness to do favors for others
definitionZh: a. 乐于施惠的, 体贴的, 有礼貌的

example.text: The obliging waiter quickly brought us extra napkins.
example.translationZh: 那位乐于助人的服务员迅速给我们拿来了额外的餐巾纸。

definitionEn: n. any grammatical case other than the nominative\na. slanting or inclined in direction or course or position--neither parallel nor perpendicular nor right-angled
definitionZh: a. 斜的, 倾斜的, 间接的, 不光明正大的, 躲躲闪闪的\n[医] 斜的

example.text: She gave him an oblique glance across the crowded room.
example.translationZh: 她隔着拥挤的房间斜瞟了他一眼。

definitionEn: s. (followed by `to' or `of') lacking conscious awareness of
definitionZh: a. 遗忘的, 健忘的, 不知不觉的\n[法] 忘却的, 健忘的, 不在意的

example.text: She was so absorbed in her book that she was completely oblivious to the storm raging outside.
example.translationZh: 她太专注于看书，完全没有察觉到外面肆虐的暴风雨。

definitionEn: n. a plane figure that deviates from a square or circle due to elongation\ns. (of a leaf shape) having a somewhat elongated form with approximately parallel sides\ns. deviating from a square or circle or sphere by being elongated in one direction
definitionZh: n. 长方形, 长椭圆形\na. 长方形的, 长椭圆形的

example.text: She placed the vase in the center of the oblong table.
example.translationZh: 她把花瓶放在长方形桌子的中央。

definitionEn: s causing disapproval or protest
definitionZh: a. 可憎的, 使人不愉快的, 令人讨厌的

example.text: His obnoxious behavior at the party made everyone uncomfortable.
example.translationZh: 他在聚会上的令人讨厌的行为让每个人都感到不舒服。

definitionEn: s. designed to incite to indecency or lust
definitionZh: a. 淫秽的, 猥亵的, 讨人厌的, 可憎的\n[法] 猥亵的, 海洋的, 污秽的

example.text: She received an obscene phone call from a stranger.
example.translationZh: 她接到一个陌生人打来的猥亵电话。

definitionEn:
v. make less visible or unclear
v. make obscure or unclear
v. reduce a vowel to a neutral one, such as a schwa
v. make undecipherable or imperceptible by obscuring or concealing
definitionZh: a. 模糊的, 昏暗的, 难解的, 晦涩的, 偏僻的, 微贱的, 无名的\nvt. 使变暗, 隐藏, 使变模糊, 使难解

example.text: The politician tried to obscure the truth with misleading statements.
example.translationZh: 那位政客试图用误导性的言论来掩盖真相。

definitionEn:
n the act of observing; taking a patient look
n a formal event performed on a special occasion
n the act of noticing or paying attention
n conformity with law or custom or practice etc.
definitionZh: n. 观察, 遵守, 仪式, 风俗习惯\n[法] 遵守, 奉行, 惯例

example.text: The school requires strict observance of its safety regulations.
example.translationZh: 学校要求严格遵守其安全规定。

definitionEn:
n. the act of making and recording a measurement
n. the act of observing; taking a patient look
n. a remark expressing careful consideration
n. facts learned by observing
definitionZh: n. 观察, 注意, 观测, 观察力\n[化] 观察

example.text: The patient was kept under observation for two days.
example.translationZh: 这位病人被留院观察了两天。

definitionEn: n. a building designed and equipped to observe astronomical phenomena
definitionZh: n. 天文台, 气象台, 了望台

example.text: We drove up the mountain to visit the astronomical observatory.
example.translationZh: 我们开车上山去参观那座天文台。

definitionEn:
v. watch attentively
v. behave as expected during of holidays or rites
v. stick to correctly or closely
v. conform one's action or practice to
definitionZh: vt. 觉察到, 遵守, 注意到, 庆祝\nvi. 注意, 评论

example.text: All visitors must observe the safety rules inside the laboratory.
example.translationZh: 所有访客在实验室内都必须遵守安全规则。

definitionEn: v. be preoccupied with something
definitionZh: vt. 迷住, 使困扰

example.text: She is so obsessed with her new video game that she forgets to eat.
example.translationZh: 她对新电子游戏如此着迷，以至于忘了吃饭。

definitionEn: n. an unhealthy and compulsive preoccupation with something or someone
definitionZh: n. 困扰, 困扰人的情绪\n[医] 强迫观念

example.text: His obsession with winning made him neglect his family.
example.translationZh: 他对胜利的痴迷使他忽视了家人。

definitionEn: s no longer in use
definitionZh: a. 荒废的, 成废物的, 陈旧的, 老式的\nn. 废词, 废物

example.text: Many factories still rely on obsolete machinery that wastes energy.
example.translationZh: 许多工厂仍在使用浪费能源的过时机器。

definitionEn: n. something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted\nn. an obstruction that stands in the way (and must be removed or surmounted or circumvented)
definitionZh: n. 障碍, 妨害物, 阻碍

example.text: Lack of funding was a major obstacle to the project's completion.
example.translationZh: 缺乏资金是项目完成的主要障碍。

definitionEn: v. persist stubbornly
definitionZh: a. 倔强的, 顽固的, 不让步的

example.text: Her obstinate refusal to apologize only made the argument worse.
example.translationZh: 她固执地拒绝道歉，只会让争吵变得更糟。

definitionEn: v. hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of\nv. block passage through\nv. shut out from view or get in the way so as to hide from sight
definitionZh: vt. 阻隔, 妨碍, 阻塞, 遮没\nvi. 设障碍

example.text: The company was accused of trying to obstruct justice by hiding key documents from investigators.
example.translationZh: 该公司被指控向调查人员隐瞒关键文件，试图妨碍司法公正。

definitionEn:
n. reason
n. the time of a particular event
n. an opportunity to do something
v. give occasion to
definitionZh: n. 场合, 时机, 机会, 诱因, 理由\nvt. 惹起, 引起

example.text: She still visits her old neighborhood on occasion.
example.translationZh: 她偶尔还会去看看自己以前住过的街区。

definitionEn: n someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
definitionZh: n. 居住者；购买者；租赁人（occupant的复数）

example.text: The new tenants repainted the apartment that the previous occupants had left in poor condition.
example.translationZh: 新租户把前任住户弄得状况不佳的公寓重新粉刷了一遍。

definitionEn:
n. the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
n. the control of a country by military forces of a foreign power
n. any activity that occupies a person's attention
n. the act of occupying or taking possession of a building
definitionZh: n. 职业, 占有, 占有期, 占领, 占领军\n[经] 占有, 占用, 职业

example.text: Please state your name and occupation on the form.
example.translationZh: 请在表格上填写你的姓名和职业。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to the activity or business for which you are trained
definitionZh: a. 职业的, 军事占领的\n[医] 职业的

example.text: Hearing loss is a common occupational hazard for factory workers.
example.translationZh: 听力损失是工厂工人常见的职业危害。

definitionEn: n. an instance of something occurring
definitionZh: n. 发生, 事件, 出现\n[医] 发生

example.text: Power outages are a rare occurrence in this neighborhood.
example.translationZh: 在这个社区，停电是罕见的事。

definitionEn: n. a large body of water constituting a principal part of the hydrosphere\nn. anything apparently limitless in quantity or volume
definitionZh: n. 海洋, 广阔, 许多, 一大片\n[法] 海洋, 海

example.text: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
example.translationZh: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。

definitionEn: n. the month following September and preceding November
definitionZh: n. 十月

example.text: The leaves usually start turning red in October.
example.translationZh: 树叶通常在十月开始变红。

definitionEn: n. the likelihood of a thing occurring rather than not occurring\nn. the ratio by which one better's wager is greater than that of another
definitionZh: n. 可能性, 几率, 机会, 胜算, 不平等

example.text: She finished the marathon against the odds after injuring her ankle.
example.translationZh: 尽管脚踝受伤，她还是克服重重困难跑完了马拉松。

phrase.translationZh: 尽管困难重重；在不利的情况下

definitionEn: n the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form\nn any property detected by the olfactory system
definitionZh: n. 气味, 臭气, 香气, 味道, 迹象, 名誉, 声誉\n[医] 气味

example.text: A strange odour was coming from the kitchen.
example.translationZh: 厨房里传来一股奇怪的气味。

definitionEn: n. a long wandering and eventful journey\nn. a Greek epic poem (attributed to Homer) describing the journey of Odysseus after the fall of Troy
definitionZh: n. 奥德赛(古希腊史诗)

example.text: Her year abroad became a personal odyssey of self-discovery.
example.translationZh: 她在国外的那一年成为了一段自我发现的个人探索历程。

phrase.translationZh: 一段个人的漫长探索历程

definitionEn:
n the action of attacking an enemy
n the team that has the ball (or puck) and is trying to score
n a feeling of anger caused by being offended
n a lack of politeness; a failure to show regard for others; wounding the feelings or others
n (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
definitionZh: n. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 罪过, 过错, 攻击\n[法] 犯法, 罪过, 过错

example.text: She took offence at his remark and left the room.
example.translationZh: 她对他的话感到生气，离开了房间。

definitionEn:
v cause to feel resentment or indignation
v act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
v strike with disgust or revulsion
v hurt the feelings of
definitionZh: v. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 进攻

example.text: His remarks offended against the basic rules of polite debate.
example.translationZh: 他的言论违反了礼貌辩论的基本规则。

definitionEn:
n. the verbal act of offering
n. something offered (as a proposal or bid)
v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish
v. present for acceptance or rejection
definitionZh: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价\nvt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出\nvi. 出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚

example.text: She offered to help me with my homework.
example.translationZh: 她主动提出帮我做作业。

definitionEn:
n. place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
n. (of a government or government official) holding an office means being in power
n. professional or clerical workers in an office
n. a religious rite or service prescribed by ecclesiastical authorities
definitionZh: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责\n[化] 办公室

example.text: She was transferred to the company's head office in London.
example.translationZh: 她被调到了公司位于伦敦的总部。

definitionEn: n. a person authorized to serve in a position of authority on a vessel\nv. direct or command as an officer
definitionZh: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员\nvt. 指挥

example.text: The officer ordered the crew to prepare for departure.
example.translationZh: 这位军官命令船员准备出发。

definitionEn: a. (of winds) coming from the land\ns. at some distance from the shore\nr. away from shore; away from land
definitionZh: a. 海面的, 吹向海面的, 近海的\nadv. 向海面

example.text: The offshore wind carried the sailboat quickly away from the coast.
example.translationZh: 离岸风把帆船迅速吹离了海岸。

definitionEn: n. the immediate descendants of a person\nn. something that comes into existence as a result
definitionZh: n. 子孙, 后代, 产物\n[法] 后辈, 子孙, 后裔

example.text: The two species rarely interbreed, so their offspring are seldom fertile.
example.translationZh: 这两个物种很少杂交，因此它们的后代很少具有生育能力。

definitionEn: abbr. overhead projector; a device that projects images from a transparency onto a screen
definitionZh: abbr. overhead projection 高架发射, 顶置防护; oxygen at high pressure 高压氧气

example.text: The teacher placed the diagram on the OHP so the whole class could see it.
example.translationZh: 老师把图表放在高架投影仪上，让全班同学都能看到。

phrase.translationZh: 在课堂上使用高架投影仪

definitionEn: n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water\nn. oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist\nv. cover with oil, as if by rubbing
definitionZh: n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料\nvt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于\nvi. 加燃油, 融化

example.text: She drizzled a little olive oil over the salad.
example.translationZh: 她在沙拉上淋了一点橄榄油。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to the Olympic Games
definitionZh: a. 奥林匹亚的, 奥林匹斯山的, 强有力的, 巨大的

example.text: The Olympic Games are held every four years.
example.translationZh: 奥林匹克运动会每四年举行一次。

definitionEn: n. a sign of something about to happen
definitionZh: n. 预兆, 前兆, 征兆\nvt. 预示, 有...的前兆, 显出...的预兆

example.text: The sudden sunshine on their wedding day seemed like a good omen for their future together.
example.translationZh: 他们婚礼当天突然放晴，似乎预示着他们未来共同生活的好兆头。

definitionEn: s threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments\ns presaging ill fortune
definitionZh: a. 恶兆的, 不吉利的, 预兆的

example.text: When the lights flickered and an ominous silence fell over the room, everyone knew something was wrong.
example.translationZh: 当灯光闪烁，房间里陷入一片不祥的寂静时，大家都知道出事了。

definitionEn: v prevent from being included or considered or accepted\nv leave undone or leave out
definitionZh: vt. 省略, 删除, 疏忽, 遗漏\n[化] 省略

example.text: Please omit the last paragraph from the final report.
example.translationZh: 请从最终报告中省略最后一段。

definitionEn:
a. in operation or operational
a. (of events) planned or scheduled
r. indicates continuity or persistence or concentration
r. in a state required for something to function or be effective

prep. 在...之上
adv. ...上去
a. 正起作用的
[计] 打开

example.text: The train arrived exactly on time despite the heavy snow.
example.translationZh: 尽管下着大雪，火车还是准时到达了。

definitionEn: r. on one occasion\nr. as soon as\nr. at a previous time;

adv. 一次, 曾经, 一旦
conj. 一旦, 一经

a. 从前的

example.text: Once you start, you cannot stop.
example.translationZh: 一旦开始，你就停不下来。

definitionEn:
n. the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
n. a single person or thing

n. 一(个)
pron. 一, 任何人
num. 一, 一个
a. 一致的, 完整的

example.text: She read the letters one by one.
example.translationZh: 她一封接一封地读着那些信。

definitionEn: a on a regular route of a railroad or bus or airline system\na connected to a computer network or accessible by computer\ns being in progress now
definitionZh: [计] 联机

example.translationZh: 我通常在网上买书，因为这样更便宜也更方便。

definitionEn: n. someone who looks on
definitionZh: n. 旁观者, 袖手旁观者

example.text: She refused to be a mere onlooker and stepped in to help the injured cyclist.
example.translationZh: 她不愿只做一个旁观者，主动上前帮助那位受伤的骑车人。

definitionEn: n. the beginning or early stages
definitionZh: n. 开始, 攻击, 进攻\n[医] 起始, 开始

example.text: The first snow signaled the onset of winter in the mountains.
example.translationZh: 第一场雪标志着山里冬天的来临。

definitionEn: a. not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy; impenetrable to sight\ns. not clearly understood or expressed
definitionZh: n. 不透明物\na. 不透明的, 不传热的, 不传导的, 阴暗的\n[计] 白底

example.text: Thick opaque curtains kept the morning sunlight out of the bedroom.
example.translationZh: 厚实不透光的窗帘把早晨的阳光挡在了卧室外面。

definitionEn: allowing or using reference materials, especially in an examination; (of a test) permitting the use of books or notes
definitionZh: a. 开卷的

example.text: The professor decided to give an open-book exam to encourage critical thinking.
example.translationZh: 教授决定举行开卷考试，以鼓励批判性思维。

definitionEn:
n. an open or empty space in or between things
n. a ceremony accompanying the start of some enterprise
n. becoming open or being made open
n. the first performance (as of a theatrical production)
definitionZh: n. 开始, 口子, 穴, 揭幕\na. 开始的

example.text: The opening ceremony of the new library will be held next Friday.
example.translationZh: 新图书馆的开幕式将于下周五举行。

definitionEn:
n. a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
n. a message expressing a belief about something; the expression of a belief that is held with confidence but not substantiated by positive knowledge or proof
n. the legal document stating the reasons for a judicial decision
n. the reason for a court's judgment (as opposed to the decision itself)
definitionZh: n. 意见, 评价, 主张\n[经] 意见

example.text: In my opinion, the new policy will help small businesses.
example.translationZh: 在我看来，这项新政策将有助于小企业。

definitionEn: s. characterized by active hostility
definitionZh: n. 对手, 敌手, 反对者\na. 敌对的, 反对的, 对面的

example.text: The senator accused his political opponent of spreading false rumors during the campaign.
example.translationZh: 这位参议员指责他的政治对手在竞选期间散布谣言。

definitionEn: n a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
definitionZh: n. 机会( opportunity的名词复数 ); 适当的时机; 条件; 就业（或晋升、进步等）的良机

example.translationZh: 新政策旨在为所有学生创造平等机会。

definitionEn: n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
definitionZh: n. 机会, 时机

example.text: She seized the opportunity to study abroad for a year.
example.translationZh: 她抓住机会出国学习了一年。

definitionZh: vt. 反对, 以...对抗, 抗争\nvi. 反对

example.text: Many residents strongly oppose the plan to build a new factory near the river.
example.translationZh: 许多居民强烈反对在河边建新工厂的计划。

definitionEn:
s. being directly across from each other; facing
a. of leaves etc; growing in pairs on either side of a stem
s. moving or facing away from each other
s. the other one of a complementary pair
definitionZh: a. 相对的, 相反的, 对面的\nprep. 对面\nn. 对立面

example.text: The bank is on the opposite side of the street, right across from the park.
example.translationZh: 银行在街道的对面，就在公园的正对面。

definitionEn: v. come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority
definitionZh: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼

example.text: The dictator used the army to oppress anyone who dared to speak out against him.
example.translationZh: 那个独裁者动用军队压迫任何敢于公开反对他的人。

definitionEn: v select as an alternative over another
definitionZh: vi. 选择

example.text: After comparing the two plans, we decided to opt for the cheaper one.
example.translationZh: 比较了两份方案之后，我们决定选择较便宜的那一个。

definitionEn: n the organ of sight\na of or relating to or resembling the eye\na relating to or using sight
definitionZh: a. 眼睛的, 视觉的, 光学的\nn. 镜片

example.text: The doctor examined the patient's optic nerve to check for any damage.
example.translationZh: 医生检查了病人的视神经，看是否有任何损伤。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to or involving light or optics
definitionZh: a. 眼睛的, 视觉的, 光学的\n[机] 光学上的, 光学的

example.text: The desert heat created an optical illusion, making the travelers think they saw water ahead.
example.translationZh: 沙漠的酷热造成了视觉错觉，让旅行者们以为前方有水。

definitionEn: n. the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well\nn. a general disposition to expect the best in all things
definitionZh: n. 乐观主义, 乐观, 乐天\n[医] 乐观主义, 乐观

example.text: Despite the economic slowdown, analysts expressed cautious optimism about the coming year.
example.translationZh: 尽管经济放缓，分析人士对来年表示了谨慎的乐观。

definitionEn: n. most favorable conditions or greatest degree or amount possible under given circumstances\ns. most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
definitionZh: n. 最适条件, 最佳效果\na. 最优的, 最适宜的

example.translationZh: 这些植物在光照和温度的最适条件下生长得最好。

definitionEn: a. possible but not necessary; left to personal choice
definitionZh: a. 可选择的, 随意的\n[化] 选购的

example.text: The sunroof is an optional feature on this car model.
example.translationZh: 天窗是这款车型的可选配置。

definitionEn: n the right to buy or sell property at an agreed price; the right is purchased and if it is not exercised by a stated date the money is forfeited\nn one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen\nn the act of choosing or selecting

example.text: Before deciding on a career change, she took time to weigh the options carefully.
example.translationZh: 在决定转行之前，她花了时间仔细权衡各种选择。

definitionEn:
n. an examination conducted by spoken communication
s. using speech rather than writing
a. of or relating to or affecting or for use in the mouth
a. of or involving the mouth or mouth region or the surface on which the mouth is located

example.text: Students must pass both a written test and an oral examination to receive the certificate.
example.translationZh: 学生必须通过笔试和口试才能获得证书。

definitionEn: n. the (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another\nn. the path of an electron around the nucleus of an atom
definitionZh: n. 轨道, 常轨, 眼眶\nvt. 绕...轨道而行\nvi. 进入轨道, 盘旋

example.text: The satellite has been in orbit around the Earth for ten years.
example.translationZh: 这颗卫星已经在地球轨道上运行了十年。

definitionEn: n garden consisting of a small cultivated wood without undergrowth
definitionZh: n. 果园, 果树林

example.translationZh: 这位农民在他的果园里种植了好几个品种的梨。

definitionEn: n. a musical organization consisting of a group of instrumentalists including string players\nn. seating on the main floor in a theater
definitionZh: n. 管弦乐队, 乐队演奏处

example.translationZh: 她在该市的交响乐团拉小提琴。

definitionEn: n. a severe or trying experience\nn. a primitive method of determining a person's guilt or innocence by subjecting the accused person to dangerous or painful tests believed to be under divine control; escape was usually taken as a sign of innocence
definitionZh: n. 严酷考验, 痛苦经历, 煎熬\n[法] 神裁判法, 严酷的考验, 痛苦的经验

example.text: She went through a terrifying ordeal when her car broke down on a deserted road at night.
example.translationZh: 当她的车在夜里于一条偏僻的路上抛锚时，她经历了一场可怕的磨难。

definitionEn:
n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed
n. a degree in a continuum of size or quantity
n. established customary state (especially of society)
n. a commercial document used to request someone to supply something in return for payment and providing specifications and quantities

vt. 整理, 命令, 定购
n. 顺序, 阶数
[计] 顺序, 阶数

example.text: The officer gave an order to evacuate the building immediately.
example.translationZh: 那名警官下令立即疏散大楼里的人员。

definitionEn: n. a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer\nn. a male hospital attendant who has general duties that do not involve the medical treatment of patients\na. devoid of violence or disruption
definitionZh: a. 有秩序的, 整齐的, 值班的\nn. 护理员, 清道夫, 传令兵, 勤务兵\nadv. 依次地, 顺序地

example.text: The nurse was an orderly who helped patients move around the ward.
example.translationZh: 那名护士是一名勤务兵，帮助病人在这病区内走动。

definitionEn:
n. a judge of a probate court
n. the expected or commonplace condition or situation
n. a clergyman appointed to prepare condemned prisoners for death
n. an early bicycle with a very large front wheel and small back wheel
definitionZh: a. 平常的, 普通的, 平凡的\nn. 平常的人(或事)

example.text: It was an ordinary day until the letter arrived.
example.translationZh: 在信到来之前，那是普普通通的一天。

definitionEn: n. a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined\nn. a monetary subunit in Denmark and Norway and Sweden; 100 ore equal 1 krona
definitionZh: n. 矿石\n[经] 矿

example.text: The company mines iron ore in the mountains of northern Sweden.
example.translationZh: 这家公司在瑞典北部的山区开采铁矿石。

definitionEn:
n. a fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function
n. a government agency or instrument devoted to the performance of some specific function
n. a periodical that is published by a special interest group
n. wind instrument whose sound is produced by means of pipes arranged in sets supplied with air from a bellows and controlled from a large complex musical keyboard
definitionZh: n. 风琴, 器官, 元件, 机构, 机关\n[电] 风琴

example.text: The heart is a vital organ that pumps blood throughout the body.
example.translationZh: 心脏是一个重要的器官，负责将血液泵送到全身。

definitionEn:
n. a fertilizer that is derived from animal or vegetable matter
a. relating or belonging to the class of chemical compounds having a carbon basis
a. being or relating to or derived from or having properties characteristic of living organisms
a. involving or affecting physiology or bodily organs
definitionZh: a. 器官的, 有机的, 组织的, 根本的\n[医] 器官的, 有生命的, 有机的, 器质的

example.text: She only buys organic food at the local market.
example.translationZh: 她只在当地市场购买有机食品。

definitionEn: n. a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently\nn. a system considered analogous in structure or function to a living body
definitionZh: n. 生物, 有机体, 社会组织\n[医] 生物[体],[有]机体

example.text: A single-celled organism can reproduce without a mate.
example.translationZh: 单细胞生物无需配偶即可繁殖。

definitionEn:
n. a group of people who work together
n. the act of organizing a business or an activity related to a business
n. an ordered manner; orderliness by virtue of being methodical and well organized
n. the activity or result of distributing or disposing persons or things properly or methodically
definitionZh: n. 组织, 结构, 团体, 体制\n[医] 组织, 机构, 机化(血栓或坏死组织)

example.text: She works for a large international organization based in Geneva.
example.translationZh: 她在一家总部设在日内瓦的大型国际组织工作。

definitionEn: n. a person who brings order and organization to an enterprise\nn. someone who enlists workers to join a union
definitionZh: n. 组织者, 编制者, 创立者, 组织导体\n[医] 组织导体, 机化中心(胚)

example.text: The organizer reserved the hall and arranged the seating for the conference.
example.translationZh: 组织者预订了大厅并为会议安排了座位。

definitionEn: n. a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)\ns. denoting or characteristic of countries of Asia
definitionZh: n. 东方人, 亚洲人\na. 东方诸国的, 亚洲的, 东方的

example.text: The museum has a fine collection of Oriental art.
example.translationZh: 这家博物馆收藏着精美的东方艺术品。

definitionEn:
n. the act of orienting
n. an integrated set of attitudes and beliefs
n. position or alignment relative to points of the compass or other specific directions
n. a person's awareness of self with regard to position and time and place and personal relationships
definitionZh: n. 定方位, 适应, 向东方\nn. 方向\n[计] 方向

example.text: The company has a policy that prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation.
example.translationZh: 该公司有一项政策，禁止基于性取向的歧视。

definitionEn:
n. properties attributable to your ancestry
n. an event that is a beginning; a first part or stage of subsequent events
n. the point of intersection of coordinate axes; where the values of the coordinates are all zero
n. the source of something's existence or from which it derives or is derived
definitionZh: n. 起源, 起因, 出身, 开端\n[计] 原点; 起始地址; 信件来源的相关数据

example.text: Please write your country of origin on the application form.
example.translationZh: 请在申请表上写明你的原籍国。

definitionEn:
n. something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies
s. preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed
s. (of e.g. information) not secondhand or by way of something intermediary
a. being or productive of something fresh and unusual; or being as first made or thought of
definitionZh: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的\nn. 原物, 原作

example.text: Her original idea impressed the whole team.
example.translationZh: 她的原创想法给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

definitionEn: v. come into existence; take on form or shape\nv. bring into being\nv. begin a trip at a certain point, as of a plane, train, bus, etc.
definitionZh: vt. 创始, 发明, 发起\nvi. 发源, 发生, 起航\n[计] 发自

example.text: Many English words originate from Latin and Greek.
example.translationZh: 许多英语单词起源于拉丁语和希腊语。

definitionEn: v. be an ornament to
definitionZh: n. 装饰, 点缀品, 教堂用品\nvt. 装饰, 修饰

example.text: She hung a glass ornament on the tree.
example.translationZh: 她把一个玻璃装饰品挂在了树上。

definitionEn: a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of Judaism\na. adhering to what is commonly accepted\na. of or relating to or characteristic of the Eastern Orthodox Church
definitionZh: a. 正统的, 传统的, 惯常的

example.text: Many patients turn to herbal remedies when orthodox medicine fails to relieve their symptoms.
example.translationZh: 当正统医学无法缓解症状时，许多患者会转而求助于草药疗法。

definitionEn: v. move or swing from side to side regularly
definitionZh: vi. 振动, 彷徨, 犹豫\nvt. 使振动, 使动摇

example.text: The committee continued to oscillate between the two proposals without reaching a decision.
example.translationZh: 委员会在两项提案之间摇摆不定，始终未能做出决定。

phrase.translationZh: 在两个选择之间摇摆不定

definitionEn: s. represented or appearing as such; pretended
definitionZh: a. 表面的, 假装的, 看得出的\n[经] 表面的, 诡称的

example.text: His ostensible reason for resigning was poor health, but everyone knew he had been offered a better position elsewhere.
example.translationZh: 他辞职的表面理由是身体不好，但大家都知道他在别处得到了更好的职位。

definitionEn: n. a gaudy outward display\nn. lack of elegance as a consequence of being pompous and puffed up with vanity\nn. pretentious or showy or vulgar display
definitionZh: n. 虚饰, 虚有其表, 卖弄

example.text: The dictator's palace was built purely for ostentation, flaunting his wealth to the world.
example.translationZh: 独裁者的宫殿纯粹是为了炫耀而建，向世界炫耀他的财富。

definitionEn: s. other than as supposed or expected\nr. in other respects or ways
definitionZh: adv. 否则, 不同地, 别的方式

example.text: Please arrive at nine o'clock unless told otherwise.
example.translationZh: 请九点到，除非另有通知。

definitionEn: v. remove from a position or office\nv. remove and replace
definitionZh: vt. 逐出, 罢黜, 剥夺, 驱逐\n[法] 驱逐, 剥夺, 免职

example.text: The board voted to oust the CEO after the scandal.
example.translationZh: 丑闻发生后，董事会投票罢免了首席执行官。

definitionEn: n. a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
definitionZh: n. 爆发, 暴动\n[医] 暴发

example.text: The government quickly sent troops to the region after an outbreak of violence.
example.translationZh: 暴力事件爆发后，政府迅速向该地区派遣了军队。

definitionEn: n. a person who is rejected (from society or home)
definitionZh: a. 被逐出的, 被遗弃的, 无家可归的\nn. 被驱逐的人, 流浪者

example.text: After the scandal, he felt like a social outcast in his small town.
example.translationZh: 丑闻发生后，他在小镇上觉得自己像个社会弃儿。

definitionEn: n a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition\nv shout louder than\nv utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
definitionZh: n. 尖叫, 倒彩, 强烈抗议, 喊价\nvi. 喊叫\nvt. 叫得比...响

example.text: The new tax law sparked a public outcry across the country.
example.translationZh: 这项新税法在全国引发了公众的强烈抗议。

definitionEn: s. old; no longer valid or fashionable
definitionZh: a. 旧式的, 落伍的, 过时的

example.text: Many companies still rely on outdated technology, which slows down their daily operations.
example.translationZh: 许多公司仍然依赖过时的技术，这拖慢了它们的日常运营。

definitionEn: v. get the better of
definitionZh: vt. 超越, 胜过, 战胜

example.text: She trained hard all year to outdo her previous best time in the marathon.
example.translationZh: 她全年刻苦训练，力求在马拉松比赛中超越自己以往的最好成绩。

phrase.translationZh: 超越自我；表现得比以往更好

definitionEn: n. any cohesive unit such as a military company\nn. a set of clothing (with accessories)
definitionZh: n. 用具, 配备, 机构\nvt. 配备, 供应\nvi. 得到装备

example.text: She wore a complete outfit for the interview, including a jacket, blouse, and matching skirt.
example.translationZh: 她为面试穿了一整套衣服，包括一件夹克、一件衬衫和一条配套的裙子。

definitionEn: v. declare illegal; outlaw
definitionZh: n. 被剥夺法律保护的人, 罪犯\nvt. 使...失去法律保护, 将...逐出社会, 宣告非法, 取缔

example.text: The government moved to outlaw the practice of selling tobacco to minors.
example.translationZh: 政府采取措施取缔向未成年人出售烟草的行为。

definitionEn:
n a place of business for retailing goods
n receptacle providing a place in a wiring system where current can be taken to run electrical devices
n an opening that permits escape or release
n activity that frees or expresses creative energy or emotion
definitionZh: n. 出口, 发泄方法, 市场\n[医] 出口

example.translationZh: 她把台灯插进了书桌旁的电源插座。

definitionEn: n. the line that appears to bound an object\nn. a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory\nn. a schematic or preliminary plan
definitionZh:
n. 大纲, 轮廓, 概要
vt. 描画轮廓, 描述要点
n. 大纲, 分级, 轮廓
[计] 大纲, 分级, 轮廓

example.text: Before writing the essay, she drew up an outline of her main arguments.
example.translationZh: 写这篇文章之前，她先起草了主要论点的提纲。

definitionEn: s. relatively far from a center or middle
definitionZh: a. 在外的, 边远的, 偏僻的, 题外的

example.text: The clinic provides medical care to people in outlying villages.
example.translationZh: 这家诊所为偏远村庄的人们提供医疗服务。

definitionEn: s grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror\ns greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
definitionZh: a. 暴虐的, 极无礼的, 可恶的

example.text: The judge called the company's outrageous behavior completely unacceptable.
example.translationZh: 法官称该公司的恶劣行为完全不可接受。

definitionEn: s. without reservation or exception\nr. without restrictions or stipulations or further payments\nr. without reservation or concealment
definitionZh: a. 率直的, 完全的, 总共的, 直率的\nadv. 完全地, 率直地, 立刻地, 一直向前

example.text: She accused him of telling an outright lie about where the money went.
example.translationZh: 她指责他在钱的去向问题上撒了彻头彻尾的谎。

definitionEn: n the time at which something is supposed to begin
definitionZh: n. 着手, 开头, 最初

example.text: She made her goals clear at the outset of the project.
example.translationZh: 她在项目开始时就把目标讲清楚了。

definitionEn: n. outlying areas (as of a city or town)
definitionZh: n. 近郊, 市郊

example.text: They bought a small house on the outskirts of the city to escape the noise.
example.translationZh: 他们在市郊买了一栋小房子，以远离喧嚣。

definitionEn: s. given to expressing yourself freely or insistently
definitionZh: a. 直言无讳的, 坦率的, 坦白无隐的

example.translationZh: 她长期以来一直是政府教育政策的直言不讳的批评者。

definitionEn: v be or do something to a greater degree\nv go far ahead of
definitionZh: vt. 追过, 胜过, 凌驾

example.text: With its new electric model, the company hopes to outstrip the competition in both range and price.
example.translationZh: 凭借其新款电动车型，该公司希望在续航里程和价格两方面都超越竞争对手。

definitionEn: v. be heavier than
definitionZh: vt. 比...重, 比...重要, 比...有价值

example.text: The benefits of regular exercise far outweigh the risks for most people.
example.translationZh: 对大多数人来说，经常锻炼的好处远远超过其风险。

definitionEn: n a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it\ns rounded like an egg
definitionZh: n. 椭圆形\na. 卵形的, 椭圆形的

example.text: The swimming pool has an oval shape.
example.translationZh: 这个游泳池呈椭圆形。

definitionEn: n. enthusiastic recognition (especially one accompanied by loud applause)
definitionZh: n. 热烈欢迎, 大喝采, 小凯旋式

example.text: The audience gave the young violinist a standing ovation.
example.translationZh: 观众起立为这位年轻的小提琴手热烈鼓掌。

definitionEn: v. get on top of; deal with successfully
definitionZh: vt. 战胜, 克服, 胜过\nvi. 得胜

example.text: With her teammates' support, she overcame her fear of public speaking.
example.translationZh: 在队友的支持下，她克服了当众演讲的恐惧。

definitionEn: s past due; not paid at the scheduled time
definitionZh: a. 过期的, 未兑的, 迟到的, 早就成熟的\n[经] 过期未付的

example.text: The library sent me a reminder about an overdue book.
example.translationZh: 图书馆给我发了一条关于逾期未还图书的提醒。

definitionEn: n. the occurrence of surplus liquid (as water) exceeding the limit or capacity\nv. flow or run over (a limit or brim)
definitionZh: n. 溢值, 超值, 泛滥\nv. (使)泛滥, (使)溢出, (使)充溢\n[计] 上溢; 溢出

example.text: The river overflowed its banks after three days of heavy rain.
example.translationZh: 连续三天大雨后，河水漫过了河岸。

definitionEn: n. periodic maintenance on a car or machine\nv. make repairs, renovations, revisions or adjustments to
definitionZh: vt. 分解检查, 翻修, 精细检查, 彻底革新\nn. 分解检查, 精细检查, 大检修

example.text: The old bus needs a major overhaul before it can run again.
example.translationZh: 那辆旧公交车需要大修后才能再次运行。

definitionEn:
n. (nautical) the top surface of an enclosed space on a ship
n. a hard return hitting the tennis ball above your head
a. located or originating from above
r. above your head; in the sky

n. 经常开支, 普通用费, 天花板
a. 在头上的, 高架的
adv. 在头顶上, 在空中, 在高处, 从头到脚全部没入地
[计] 总开销; 额外开销

example.text: The company cut its overhead costs by moving to a smaller office.
example.translationZh: 公司通过搬到更小的办公室削减了经常开支。

definitionEn: v hear, usually without the knowledge of the speakers
definitionZh: vt. 无意中听到, 偷听

example.text: She happened to overhear a conversation about the surprise party.
example.translationZh: 她碰巧无意中听到了一段关于惊喜派对的对话。

definitionEn: n. a high place affording a good view\nv. look past, fail to notice\nv. watch over
definitionZh: vt. 俯瞰, 远眺, 没注意到\nn. 眺望, 俯瞰到的景色

example.text: From the top of the hill, you can overlook the entire valley.
example.translationZh: 从山顶上，你可以俯瞰整个山谷。

definitionEn:
n. a manually operated device to correct the operation of an automatic device
v. prevail over
v. counteract the normal operation of (an automatic gear shift in a vehicle)
v. ride (a horse) too hard
definitionZh: vt. 推翻, 无视, 对...有最后发言权, 制服, 践踏, 奔越过\n[经] 代理佣金, 代销佣金

example.text: In case of emergency, you can use the manual override to open the door.
example.translationZh: 在紧急情况下，你可以使用手动超控来打开门。

definitionEn: v. rule against
definitionZh: vt. 统治, 威压, 打败, 驳回\n[法] 否决, 驳回, 批驳

example.text: The judge overruled the lawyer's objection and allowed the witness to continue.
example.translationZh: 法官驳回了律师的异议，允许证人继续作证。

definitionEn: v. seize the position of and defeat\nv. run beyond or past
definitionZh:
n. 蔓延, 风行一时, 超过限度
vt. 蔓延, 蹂躏, 超过, 泛滥
vi. 泛滥, 超载限度
[计] 超限

example.text: The small town was overrun with tourists during the summer festival.
example.translationZh: 夏季庆典期间，这个小镇挤满了游客。

definitionEn: v. watch and direct
definitionZh: vt. 向下看, 了望, 监督, 偷看到\n[法] 监察, 监督, 俯瞰

example.text: She was hired to oversee the construction of the new bridge.
example.translationZh: 她受聘监督这座新桥的建设。

definitionEn: a. open and observable; not secret or hidden
definitionZh: a. 明显的, 公然的, 蓄意的\n[法] 明显的, 公开的

example.text: The company was sued for overt discrimination against older employees.
example.translationZh: 该公司因对年长员工的公开歧视而被起诉。

definitionEn: v. catch up with and possibly overtake
definitionZh: vt. 赶上, 突然降临于, 压倒, 代替

example.text: It is dangerous to overtake a car on a blind curve.
example.translationZh: 在视线受阻的弯道上超车很危险。

definitionEn: n. the termination of a ruler or institution (especially by force)\nv. cause the downfall of; of rulers
definitionZh: n. 推翻, 瓦解, 倾覆\nvt. 打倒, 推翻, 倾覆

example.text: The rebels plotted to overthrow the government.
example.translationZh: 叛乱者密谋推翻政府。

definitionEn: n. orchestral music played at the beginning of an opera or oratorio\nn. a tentative suggestion designed to elicit the reactions of others
